questions.question:
Arrange the following works in chronological order of their publication or composition:

A. Tottel's Miscellany
B. The Faerie Queene
C. The Shepheards Calender
D. Astrophel and Stella
questions.explanation: Tottel's Miscellany was published in 1557 (A), The Shepheards Calender in 1579 (C), Astrophel and Stella was composed around 1581–82 (D), and The Faerie Queene was published in 1590–96 (B). The correct chronological order is A, C, D, B. Option A incorrectly places Astrophel and Stella before The Shepheards Calender. Options C and D incorrectly reorder the earliest works.
